data.one_liner: Reactive Extensions library for Dart offering observable streams and async operators.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of observable types, subjects, and operators for composing asynchronous data flows. Includes converters to and from Dart Streams and Futures, plus experimental reactive values.
use_when: You need fine‑grained control over async data pipelines
You prefer Rx‑style operators over native Stream methods
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart reactive library
avoid_when: You require a full state‑management solution
strengths: Rich set of operators and subjects
Works without depending on Dart Stream API
weaknesses: Experimental; may lack some Rx features
